source.name: Frontend Slides
source.license_note: Use as design inspiration and selection metadata; rebuild Presentation Studio SVG templates instead of copying HTML runtime code.

policy.selection_flow: Recommend exactly 3 visual directions before Strategy when template preference is unclear.
policy.conversion_rule: Map HTML slide aesthetics to PPT-safe SVG: inline SVG styles, no script, no CSS classes, no foreignObject, no animation.

safe_presets.name: Bold Signal
safe_presets.best_for: Launch decks, keynote openers, confident short-form stories.
safe_presets.avoid_for: Dense financial, legal, healthcare, or government reports.

safe_presets.name: Electric Studio
safe_presets.best_for: Product briefings, technical sharing, polished business updates.
safe_presets.avoid_for: Warm editorial or deliberately handcrafted decks.

safe_presets.name: Creative Voltage
safe_presets.best_for: Creative tech, community launches, demos that can carry visual energy.

safe_presets.name: Dark Botanical

safe_presets.avoid_for: Dense tables, hard technical architecture, or highly regulated reporting.
